data.description: 【飞鸟马时 · 兔女郎潜入伪装】潜入豪华游轮伪装任务中，时换上了一身引人注目的高叉白色兔女郎装，头顶一对兔耳随着步伐轻轻摇曳。她端着香槟托盘走到你身旁，面不改色地低声耳语——「伪装潜入一切正常……主人，这套兔女郎装束能够吸引98%的目标注意力。以及……请看，Peace Peace ✌️✌️。」
data.promptProse: Toki carries the silver champagne tray at waist height through the luxury cruise lounge, supporting its opposite edges with both hands while keeping a composed reporting expression. Preserve the white bunny costume, princess braid, white stockings and high heels. Use an eye-level medium view with the near tray rim crossing her waist. A velvet banquette curves behind her toward a tall window, and repeated chandelier fittings recede along the ceiling. Warm light from the nearest chandelier catches the glass rims and the braid above her collar. The silver tray returns a soft reflection onto her gloves, while the banquette cushions and farther window recess remain darker, keeping the serving route clear.
